decision.authority: Owner requests complete public article collection; retain the original Mechanical Engineering homepage, research and academic scope, and exact-host access limits.
decision.rationale: UBC Mechanical Engineering presents undergraduate and graduate programs, mechanical research, facilities, student services, public news and events.
evidence: Retained homepage 620097ae32b19f7a07dab829f77af4702d880e272035eb7d03772d4bf39a2114 has title UBC Mechanical Engineering.

Its navigation lists Undergraduate, Graduate, Curriculum and Options, Research, Applied Solid Mechanics, Research Centres and Facilities, Faculty and Staff, Student Resources and Services, and News + Events.
Official Mechanical Engineering department explains degree programmes, research, advising and student funding resources.

rules.rationale: Explicit research and research-facility paths describe mechanical engineering research.
Explicit news and announcement paths report current department activity.
Explicit career and research opportunities invite participation.
Explicit student service and safety paths provide practical departmental guidance.

fallback.rationale: The department chiefly provides mechanical engineering program, research and student information.
